annotations.title: Book a room, table or activity

description: Reserve a venue offer grounded by match_venues. Pass entityId and the selected offerId. The guest must approve every booking themselves, signed in to their Selfe account: the first call returns status 'approval_required' with approval.url for the guest to open; once they have approved, call again with the same offer and approvalId. A signed mandate alone cannot confirm a booking. No money moves at this step. Returns a confirmation (bookingId) or a conversational next step. Structured JSON.

inputSchema.description: Reserve one current offer for one entity. Its date, party and price are bound inside the sealed offer.

approvalId.description: The approval the guest gave this offer in their own Selfe account, returned as approval.id when the booking first needed it. A booking is confirmed only with the guest's approval.

entityId.description: The place id returned by discover or match.

mandate.description: A signed AP2 Cart Mandate for a foreign caller, bound to this entity and offer.

offerId.description: The opaque, sealed offer id returned by match.

render.description: Ask for layout hints alongside the booking result. Optional.

a2ui.description: Also return `ui`: an A2UI surface for the booking result. A hint; the result is complete without it.

catalogs.description: A2UI catalog ids the caller can render.

name: book_venue
